page_title: BAY 5-0 HOF | Bayern Munich v Hoffenheim 15/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+1' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick, but Oliver Baumann reads it well and stops the effort.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee signals a corner kick to Bayern Munich. Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
89' The corner from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by Oliver Baumann.
89' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Bayern Munich get a corner.
88' Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Manuel Neuer.
87' The referee shows the yellow card to Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim).
86' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
85' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
84' Total attempts – 21:3.
83' Bayern Munich work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
82' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Bayern Munich win a corner.
82' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
82' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Timo Gerach saw the whole situation. There is a free kick near the sideline to Bayern Munich.
81' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Thomas Muller and he is replaced by Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich).
80' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
78' A substitution has been made. Valentin Gendrey is replaced by Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim).
77' Gift Orban (Hoffenheim) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. He hits the ball poorly and sends it into orbit.
76' Bayern Munich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

76' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
76' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the corner.
75' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayern Munich are going to take it.
74' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
72' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
72' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
71' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim).

70' A dangerous attempt from Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) was aimed towards the roof of the net, but Manuel Neuer pulls off a superb save and stops this one. The linesman makes the right call and Hoffenheim will have a corner.
69' Gift Orban (Hoffenheim) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
68' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) is able to continue to play.
67' It's time for a substitution. Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) comes on in place of Leroy Sane.
67' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
66' 5 - 0 Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
64' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
63' Bayern Munich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat. The resulting corner, taken by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich), comes to nothing.
63' The referee signals a substitution. Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Adam Hlozek.
63' Here comes a substitution. Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) is given a rest as he is replaced by Finn Ole Becker.
62' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayern Munich.
61' Here is a change. Harry Kane is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich).
61' Substitution. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Dayot Upamecano walks off.
61' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Timo Gerach had an easy-decision to make.
60' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
58' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
58' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
56' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
55' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.

54' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. His dangerous effort is blocked by Oliver Baumann, who makes a glorious save!
53' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

52' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Oliver Baumann. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
50' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
50' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but Manuel Neuer comes off his line to gather the ball.
48' 4 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Mathys Tel plays it into the box, and Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom left corner. 4:0.
48' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
46' Half-time substitution. Erencan Yardimci (Hoffenheim) is replaced by Gift Orban.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Vincent Kompany probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich). He is replaced by Mathys Tel.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Oliver Baumann, who smothers the ball.
45+1' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Erencan Yardimci (Hoffenheim) is penalised for a foul. Timo Gerach had a clear view and blows his whistle.
43' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

42' What a great touch by Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Bayern Munich force their opponents to concede a corner.
41' Problems for Christian Ilzer as Diadie Samassekou is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) replaces him.
40' Diadie Samassekou (Hoffenheim) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
37' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
36' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
35' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Oliver Baumann intercepts the ball.
33' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
31' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayern Munich comes to nothing.
31' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) strikes a volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his effort. It will be a corner kick for Bayern Munich.
30' Bayern Munich enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
28' Close! Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
26' 3 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Oliver Baumann into left side of the goal.
26' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is going to take the penalty!
25' It’s a PENALTY to Bayern Munich after the VAR review!

24' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Bayern Munich.
24' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
24' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
23' The ball is cleared after Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
23' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Diadie Samassekou (Hoffenheim) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
22' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Timo Gerach blows for a foul.
20' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
20' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich will have a chance to score from a corner.
19' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

19' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
18' He should have scored! Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
17' Rough tackle by Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
15' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
12' 2 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane tees up Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 2:0.
11' A cross from Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
10' Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
9' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Timo Gerach no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick to Hoffenheim.
8' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann is prepared to thwart his effort.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Thomas Muller plays a simple square pass into the feet of Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
5' Erencan Yardimci (Hoffenheim) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
4' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) offside.
3' Erencan Yardimci (Hoffenheim) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Timo Gerach has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
2' One of the players from Bayern Munich times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Bayern Munich will have the kick-off.
Timo Gerach will referee today's match.
